name: Eccentric Heel Drop
steps: Stand with the balls of both feet on the edge of a sturdy step or stair, holding the handrail or wall for balance.
Rise up onto the toes of both feet.
Transfer all your weight onto the target leg (e.g., right foot).
Slowly lower your right heel down below the level of the step over a count of 3 to 4 seconds, loading the Achilles tendon eccentrically.
Place your left foot back on the step and use both feet to rise back up to the top, repeating the eccentric lowering on the target leg.
coaching_cues: The magic of the Alfredson protocol is the slow eccentric lowering; use both feet to push back up.
Perform with both straight knee (gastrocnemius) and slightly bent knee (soleus).
A mild ache during the stretch is expected, but avoid sharp, unbearable pain.

sources.attribution: Håkan Alfredson Heavy-Load Eccentric Calf Training
